instruction: Adjust Chrome so that the smallest font size displayed is 10 pixels to maintain legibility.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to set Chrome's minimum font size to 10 pixels. The evaluator reads the webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size setting from Chrome's Preferences file and checks if it equals 10. This ensures text on web pages will never be rendered smaller than 10 pixels, improving readability.
